rows.note: EXPECTED (written before the first start): the own stack of the body at the pad holds the Kerbin layers (4 of 5 built); at least 1 or the start measures nothing.
EXPECTED: with rtOwnClouds off (the default) there is no pack and no texture. A/B base.

EXPECTED: 4 to 60 s from the switch to the first pack. Offline (Debug build) a four-layer bake is 0.25 s without height variation and 0.62 s with it at stride 2, spread at 0.25 ms a frame: 1000 to 2500 frames. [proposed] limit 120 s.

EXPECTED: the main-thread time of one whole bake 250 to 700 ms (offline 250 ms without and 620 ms with height variation, Debug). [proposed] limit 800 ms; a bake that costs more makes the pack stale before it stands.

Not required: the first tick carries the JIT and the 4 MB allocation of the baker. EXPECTED: the worst tick of the bake 0.3 to 1.0 ms (budget 0.25 ms, plus the check interval of 64 texels and the table of a layer, offline 0.6 to 1.2 ms). [proposed] limit 2 ms: a tick above it is a hitch the bake adds.
EXPECTED: at least the first bake is done when the first pack stands.
EXPECTED: 1 to 4 ms for the 4 MB texture (LoadRawTextureData and Apply). [proposed] limit 8 ms.
EXPECTED: as upload_ms; the first upload creates the texture.

EXPECTED: 0.1 to 0.4 ms of CPU frame time while the bake runs against the same view with the switch off (budget 0.25 ms a frame). Brief limit 0.5 ms (a GPU figure in the brief; the Atmospheres side adds no GPU pass, this is the CPU). Noise of the frame time is about 0.3 ms, so the row is not required.
EXPECTED: about 0 with the pack standing (only the refresh of the live fields). Not required (noise).
EXPECTED: every layer of the stack (up to 4) is in the pack. Brief: all layers.
EXPECTED: equal to the stack's layers, at most 4.
EXPECTED: 1 MB a layer at 512 x 256 (4 MB for four layers).
EXPECTED: the texture is Width x (Height x layers).

EXPECTED: all five kinds of place exist in the sky of the start (the start must hold a broken field and a deck with an edge near the vessel; a clear sky fails this row by name, it does not pass vacuously).

Brief acceptance: the cloud shadow factor by ray (the pack's law) against the cloud shadow field at 64 steps a span within 10 percent, p1 under a broken field, sun 45 degrees. EXPECTED: 0 to 0.05 (offline 0.000 without and a median 0.035 with the height variation of T13).
p2 at an edge. EXPECTED: 0 to 0.08 (offline 0.00 at a one-texel edge with 8 taps).
p3 under a deck. EXPECTED: 0 to 0.05.
p4 behind a layer pair. EXPECTED: 0 to 0.08.
p5 at the terminator (sun 6 degrees). EXPECTED: 0 to 0.08 (offline p90 0.02, worst 0.12 over a lattice with 8 taps).

INFORMATION: the shadow pass's own field at 8 steps a span against its 64-step value. EXPECTED: 0 to 0.5 with the height variation on (offline median 0.15, p90 0.47): the reference of the raster side is itself coarse there; not a pass criterion.
EXPECTED: at least 20 places of the 41 x 41 lattice (+-4 degrees, step 0.2) with a shadow factor between 0.05 and 0.95.

[proposed] 90th percentile of the relative difference over the lattice, sun 45 degrees. EXPECTED: 0.00 to 0.05 (offline 0.0003 without, 0.10 with height variation: the real sky has it on, so the first reference run decides; never loosened afterwards).
[proposed] worst place of the lattice, sun 45 degrees. EXPECTED: 0.05 to 0.6 (offline 0.58 with height variation).
[proposed] sun 6 degrees (the chord is long). EXPECTED: 0.02 to 0.10 (offline 0.02 to 0.06 without height variation).
[proposed] sun 6 degrees. EXPECTED: 0.1 to 0.6.
EXPECTED: with rtOwnCloudsLayerCap 2 the pack holds the two lowest layers (the stack's, if it has one).
EXPECTED: the switch off frees the pack and the texture.
